column1: # The licence texts a program linking @kama/rmlui carries.
#   key       an identifier for a consumer's own manifest or credits check
#   legs      which builds CONTAIN the component: `native` (every desktop build that links this package). There is no
#             web row: @kama/rmlui is not in a wasm build (the web leg of @kama/ui is the browser's DOM).
#   licence   the SPDX-ish id, short enough for a credits screen
#   text      path to the full text, relative to this package's root. The texts are the vendored tree's own
#             (tools/vendor-rmlui.sh copies them byte for byte), never fetched at packaging time.
#   screen    the name a credits screen shows
# ⚠️ RmlUi VENDORS TWO CONTAINER LIBRARIES AND ITS LICENSE.txt DOES NOT COVER THEM. A licence audit of a shipped game
# found 472 robin_hood + itlib symbols in its binary against a notice that named neither. Their text is RmlUi's
# Include/RmlUi/Core/Containers/LICENSE.txt, a separate row because they are separate copyright holders.
# ⚠️ FreeType is not in this list: it is @kama/freetype's, a dependency, and its own licenses/manifest.tsv lists its
# texts (the FTL, taken over GPLv2, with its credit line; and the MIT notice of FreeType's hashing code).
